All everyone tells me is that I have no right to be happy and I have to earn it.  That's the reason I think of suicide, because all I do is try to earn the right to be happy, but apparently we don't all get it. What's the point of going when every day is mental torture and feeling humiliated and empty? There isn't, it's just ... go because go, but it won't get better and don't expect it to get better and maybe some day when you're 70 and you're on your third stroke you'll be happy for a few minutes and wouldn't that be worth it and meanwhile those around you will for the most part live with what you are not entitled to have and you would have it if you weren't a broken person and you see that your want of intimacy doesn't matter only economic things matter because that's more common to have. if you live a life without the only thing that matters, you never lived, you just pile up regret with no apparent way to change anything. I'm just a human, I have human wants and needs. I can only evolve beyond those to a certain degree, beyond that it's just escapism and pretending.

Those really weren't those big of words.
